label: Teltonika RUT361
description: A compact industrial cellular router: 1 WAN + 1 LAN at 10/100 and a 4G Cat 4 modem in a DIN-rail case.
notes: Vendor figures from the RUT361 datasheet: 1 x WAN Ethernet port and 1 x LAN port at 10/100 Mbps (IEEE 802.3/802.3u); 4G LTE Cat 4. No Wi-Fi is claimed here because the datasheet section confirming a radio was not captured during intake - if the unit does have one, it is a gap in this spec and worth a comment on the request.
